components.name: Ambient contrast layer and Home footer
components.description: Exact native forest scrim with the compact Home footer, illustrated on the fallback color. The bundled photo is omitted; native captures show its crop. Footer insets are 4dp top, 40dp sides and 12dp bottom, with 2dp text gaps and 20dp to the 56x48dp quiet GitHub action with 12dp corners and zero icon padding. Regular 12sp description sits above regular 11sp mist credits in a space-between FlowRow that wraps; upstream credit has 20dp trailing padding. The footer reserves actual height outside native scrolling content. The inline official 2026 Invertocat preserves the source 98x96 path and aspect ratio; the native callback and accessible name remain GitHub. Hover illustrates native D-pad focus.

components.description: Native Canvas outline only: mint #DCEBDC 3dp over forest #19362E 5dp with 6dp corners. Selected geometry is clipped to the visible viewport and bounded scroller ancestors. The 16sp hint fades after three seconds; the ring stays. Chromium owns page navigation; held OK switches to the existing pointer.

components.name: Compact webpage Phone badge
components.description: Native webpage connection status retains its legacy #25282B surface and #C7D8AF accent rather than adopting Ambient. A 24dp phone vector sits in a 48dp-square, 12dp-corner target with no visible status text. The native Phone connected accessible name, polite live region and open-panel callback remain; the native owner excludes page keyboard focus, hides the badge on Home/private tabs and disposes it on disconnect. This illustration does not implement native placement, input ownership or lifecycle.

narrative.overview:
A landscape supplies the atmosphere; forest surfaces and warm white keep the
browser legible from a couch. Filled native TV controls and pale mint focus
make the current remote target easy to find. Expression comes from scenery,
tonal layering and generous space.

This system applies to native Android TV Home, the root browser drawer and
Phone panels. It uses AndroidX Compose for TV inside Chromium's native view
and dialog ownership. The separate phone companion is documented in
[brave/DESIGN.md](brave/DESIGN.md); unrelated TV library, settings and security
panels retain their existing presentation.

Webpage navigation uses the existing forest/mint colors for a native selection ring and a brief scaled hint. Chromium owns directional target selection and scrolling.
keyCharacteristics: One bundled landscape with permanent photographer credit and fixed contrast scrims.
Forest surfaces, warm white content and a pale mint focused target.
System TV sans typography, scalable text and native D-pad buttons.
Quiet selected navigation, rounded action tiles and a single-level browser drawer.
Native state determines labels, enabled actions and return focus.

rules.name: The Scoped Theme Rule
rules.body:
Ambient color roles apply to Home, the root browser
drawer and Phone. Extend these scoped roles without changing unrelated panels
or the phone companion's palette.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body:
Keep text in native sp and preserve system font
scaling. Reflow columns and permit scrolling as text grows.

rules.name: The Focus First Rule
rules.body: Focus changes fill, content color and the two-dp outline while preserving target size. Fill, focused, pressed, disabled and focused-disabled shapes use the same radius; focused and focused-disabled borders match it explicitly. Focus, press and focused-disabled scales are 1.0. The white search stays white with a mint outline; enabled filled targets take mint fill and warm-white outline. Selected Home remains a separate persistent state.

dos: **Do** use the scoped Ambient Material color roles for Home, the root drawer and Phone.
**Do** preserve native TV type roles, sp scaling and adaptive scrollable rows.
**Do** keep focus visible, match its outline to the button fill, preserve target size, and distinguish it from persistent selected Home navigation.
**Do** use native vector icons and full accessible control names.
**Do** retain the photograph's permanent credit and fixed contrast scrims.
donts: **Don't** apply the TV Ambient palette to the separate phone companion or unrelated native panels.
**Don't** lower text scale to fit labels; use font-scaled minimum widths/heights and allow intrinsic growth and scrolling.
**Don't** replace live native status or saved/recent models with display guesses or sample content.
**Don't** let the scenic background wash out labels or remove the focused target's outline.
**Don't** convert the search launcher into a provider-branded or voice-search field that the browser does not implement.
